fact: 1948年4月3日杜鲁门签署《对外援助法》（Foreign Assistance Act of 1948），马歇尔计划正式立法实施；美国在1948-1952年向16个欧洲国家提供约130亿美元援助。

sources.title: Remarks by the Secretary of State at Harvard University on June 5, 1947 — George C. Marshall Foundation
sources.quote: The truth of the matter is that Europe's requirements for the next three or four years of foreign food and other essential products--principally from America--are so much greater than her present ability to pay that she must have substantial additional help.

fact: 1948年6月26日美国空军开始柏林空运（Operation Vittles）；到1949年9月30日正式结束时，美国共运送1,783,573吨物资，占空运总运量的约77%。

sources.title: Berlin Airlift — The National Archives, UK
sources.quote: In total, the United States and Britain delivered 1,783,573 and 541,937 tons respectively, from 277,569 flights to Berlin.

fact: 1948年11月2日美国总统大选，杜鲁门（民主党）意外击败杜威（共和党），蝉联总统；这是美国历史上最著名的选举 upsets 之一。

sources.title: U.S. Senate: Vetoes by President Harry S. Truman
sources.quote: Veto overridden by the House on Jun 20 by vote No. 85 (331-83). Veto overridden by the Senate on Jun 23 by a vote (68-25).

fact: 1948年4月7日世界卫生组织（WHO）正式成立；这是联合国下属专门机构，总部设在日内瓦。

sources.title: Clement Attlee — GOV.UK
sources.quote: Children Act 1948: established a comprehensive childcare service, reforming services for children.

fact: 1948年美国从战后调整中恢复：GDP 实际增长约4%，失业率降至约4%；通胀率从1947年的约14%回落至约8%；马歇尔计划出口订单推动美国农业与工业出口增长。

sources.title: Marshall Plan 1947-1997: A German View — George C. Marshall Foundation
sources.quote: Our policy is not directed against any country or doctrine but against hunger, poverty, desperation and chaos.

fact: 1948年贝尔实验室在1947年12月发明晶体管后继续改进；1948年7月肖克利、巴丁、布拉顿向公众公布晶体管发明，这一发明后来成为整个半导体工业的基础。

sources.title: The economic and currency reform of 1948 — Deutsche Bundesbank
sources.quote: Their key laws, enacted by the occupying powers, enter into force on 20 June 1948.

fact: 1948年美国众议院非美活动委员会（HUAC）对好莱坞电影业展开调查，10名编剧、导演与演员（即「好莱坞十君子」）因拒绝作证被判藐视国会罪。

sources.title: Taft-Hartley Act of 1947 — The First Amendment Encyclopedia, MTSU
sources.quote: The Taft-Hartley Act, known officially as the Labor-Management Relations Act, was passed by Congress on June 23, 1947, over a veto by President Harry S. Truman, who described the legislation as a "slave-labor bill."

fact: 1948年美国生活成本继续上升：纽约市房租、食品价格较1947年上涨约5-8%；但失业率降至约4%，实际工资因通胀回落而开始恢复。

sources.title: Marshall Plan 1947-1997: A German View — George C. Marshall Foundation
sources.quote: Our policy is not directed against any country or doctrine but against hunger, poverty, desperation and chaos.

fact: 1948年7月贝尔实验室公布晶体管后，半导体产业逐步衍生：1956年肖克利离开贝尔实验室在山景城创办 Shockley Semiconductor Laboratory；1957年八名核心员工离开 Shockley 创办 Fairchild Semiconductor Corporation；1968年诺伊斯与摩尔离开 Fairchild 创办 Intel Corporation；这些企业构成了硅谷半导体产业的核心。

sources.title: Fairchild, Fairchildren, and the Family Tree of Silicon Valley — Computer History Museum
sources.quote: Coupled with the proximity to Stanford University, these factors attracted co-inventor of the transistor William Shockley to establish his Shockley Semiconductor Laboratory in Mountain View in 1956 to perform research into silicon semiconductor devices. Shockley's difficult leadership style drove eight of his leading employees to defect and start their own company, Fairchild Semiconductor Corporation, in 1957. Founded by Moore and Noyce in 1968, Intel Corporation was the most influential and successful of the first generation of Fairchildren.
